video_title: “It’s Our Job To Go Out There & Compete.” | Jonathan Kuminga Postgame Sound | 10.28.26

quotes.speaker: Jonathan Kuminga
quotes.summary_phrase: Jonathan Kuminga on the impact of missing a key teammate
quotes.excerpt: A lot of people expecting us not to be as good without him.
quotes.quote: Part of us was feeling him missing, but that don't make us go out there and play well off the get. Because we knew it was going to happen. A lot of people expecting us not to be as good without him. But I think it's just, we missing him out there a lot, but it's our job to go out there and compete.
quotes.social_post: Jonathan Kuminga on playing without a key teammate: It is our job to go out there and compete. We know people expect us not to be as good without him but we have to step up.

structured.context: Jonathan Kuminga discusses the team's need to compete despite missing a key teammate.

quotes.speaker: Jonathan Kuminga
quotes.summary_phrase: Jonathan Kuminga on the team's slow start and lack of energy
quotes.excerpt: Early it seems like they didn't want to be here, they didn't want to play.
quotes.quote: I think we just came out playing the same flow as them. Because early it seems like they didn't want to be here, they didn't want to play, and it got contagious to us. I feel like we were just thinking it's going to be sweet those first couple halves and things just went a different way. I think just going forward, off the get, we just got to come out without that pressure, but we are all not ready to play, including me.
quotes.social_post: Jonathan Kuminga admits the team lacked energy early on: It seems like they did not want to be here and it got contagious to us. We were thinking it was going to be sweet but we were not ready to play including me.

structured.context: Jonathan Kuminga reflects on the team's slow start and lack of energy during a postgame interview.

quotes.speaker: Jonathan Kuminga
quotes.summary_phrase: Jonathan Kuminga on learning from mistakes and team accountability
quotes.excerpt: I think we are not going to let that repeat itself twice.
quotes.quote: I think we are not going to let that repeat itself twice. I think we learn from our mistakes. We are not going forward, a lot of people want to come here and hunt us, and I think we just go back tomorrow, watch film and practice, and all of us regroup as a team and go forward and get better from there.
quotes.social_post: Jonathan Kuminga on the team's response to a tough loss: We are not going to let that repeat itself twice. We will watch film and regroup as a team to get better.

structured.context: Jonathan Kuminga explains how the team plans to learn from their mistakes after a loss.

quotes.speaker: Jonathan Kuminga
quotes.summary_phrase: Jonathan Kuminga on the team's collective approach to scoring
quotes.excerpt: It's not about 30 shots, so we go shoot 10 or less.
quotes.quote: I think it's just collectively all of us being involved and in the game and playing for each other. It's not about 30 shots, so we go shoot 10 or less, whatever shots we got to do, we got to be ready off the get. And all that going to prevent itself, and whoever got the hot hands on that day, we just keep going with him. I think we are going to figure it out.
quotes.social_post: Jonathan Kuminga on the team's offensive philosophy: It is not about 30 shots. We have to be ready off the get and whoever has the hot hand we just keep going with him.

structured.context: Jonathan Kuminga discusses the importance of a collective approach to scoring and team play.

quotes.speaker: Jonathan Kuminga
quotes.summary_phrase: Jonathan Kuminga on his relationship with Anthony Vereen
quotes.excerpt: It goes way beyond basketball, so that's all about it.
quotes.quote: I was just talking to one of my good people out there, Anthony Vereen. I was just going back and forth with him because he used to be my PT coach and, you know, he was one of my brothers. It goes way beyond basketball, so that's all about it.
quotes.social_post: Jonathan Kuminga shares a moment with former PT coach Anthony Vereen: It goes way beyond basketball.

structured.context: Jonathan Kuminga describes his personal relationship with his former physical therapist Anthony Vereen.

quotes.speaker: Jonathan Kuminga
quotes.summary_phrase: Jonathan Kuminga on prioritizing defense this season
quotes.excerpt: My focus is just trying to be as best as I can on defense.
quotes.quote: I think the offense will bring itself at some point, but like I said early in this season, my focus is just trying to be as best as I can on defense, and the rest will just handle itself. I think I'm trying to do the best as I can. I ain't going to be perfect all the time, but trying to be perfect as much as I can, then missing up most of the time.
quotes.social_post: Jonathan Kuminga on his personal focus this season: My focus is just trying to be as best as I can on defense and the rest will handle itself. I am not going to be perfect all the time but I am trying.

structured.context: Jonathan Kuminga explains that his primary focus for the season is improving his defensive performance.

quotes.speaker: Jonathan Kuminga
quotes.summary_phrase: Jonathan Kuminga on the importance of sharing the ball
quotes.excerpt: The earlier we share the ball, the better position we going to be.
quotes.quote: I think like I said early off the get, we all try to take that seat and be the ones taking shots, including me, pretty much all of us. And I think film is going to tell us, you know, the earlier we share the ball, the better position we going to be. And like I said, and covers a lot for us, and like I said, we going to miss him, we just got to figure it out to play without him.
quotes.social_post: Jonathan Kuminga says the team needs to prioritize ball movement: Film is going to tell us the earlier we share the ball the better position we are going to be in.

structured.context: Jonathan Kuminga emphasizes the importance of sharing the ball to improve the team's offensive position.

quotes.speaker: Jonathan Kuminga
quotes.summary_phrase: Jonathan Kuminga on the bench's contribution to team energy
quotes.excerpt: They gave us a chance, they gave us hope.
quotes.quote: We nobody mad, we loving it. They gave us a chance, they gave us hope, and I think that's how it should always be for all of us. The same mindset as the guys that came off the bench, just moving the ball, playing as hard as they can. I think you just got to be the same mindset for all of us going forward throughout this season.
quotes.social_post: Jonathan Kuminga praises the bench unit for their energy: They gave us a chance and they gave us hope. That is the mindset we all need to have going forward throughout the season.

structured.context: Jonathan Kuminga praises the energy and mindset provided by the bench players.
